$comment: facts@1 — PROPOSED (graph-store plan 0.1, T1). The fact relations circle-ir owes the store, as Arrow columns in canonical order keyed by ids@0.1. Adopted when the stable-ids plan (#20) is; until then every consumer treats this file as a draft. The TypeScript mirror is src/facts/schema.ts and tests/facts/schema.test.ts locks the two together.

id_encoding.$comment: An ids@0.1 id is 128 bits printed as 26 lowercase base32 characters (RFC 4648, unpadded). In a column it is the 16 raw bytes, so every id column is FixedSizeBinary(16); the 2 trailing padding bits of the printed form are always zero.

types.$comment: The closed set of column types. `dict` is Dictionary<Int8 index, Utf8 value> over a fixed vocabulary listed on the column; the whole vocabulary is written as the dictionary, in the listed order, whether or not every value occurs.

canonical_order.$comment: Within a relation rows are sorted ascending by the key columns in key order, then by every remaining column in schema order, so the comparator is total and a relation with duplicate keys still has one byte form. Column orders: fixed16 by unsigned bytes; u32 numerically; utf8 and dict by Unicode code point (which equals UTF-8 byte order), never by UTF-16 code unit or dictionary index; bool false before true; null before every value.

chunking.$comment: After the canonical sort a relation is cut into record batches of chunk_rows rows each (the last one shorter); a relation with no rows has no record batch. One Arrow IPC file per relation, so the batch boundaries are part of the bytes. Fixed row-count chunks were chosen over the design's file_id ranges because five of the eight relations are not keyed by file_id; see the plan's open questions.

metadata.$comment: Schema-level custom metadata, and nothing else (no timestamps, no host): facts and ids always; engine and parser when the caller names them.

columns.name: file_id
columns.doc: 0-based index of the file in the snapshot's path-sorted (code point order) file list; dense and per snapshot.

columns.name: content_hash
columns.doc: blake3 of the file's UTF-8 bytes, first 16 bytes.

columns.name: signature
columns.doc: The ids@0.1 canonical signature as written; empty for modules and types without type parameters.

columns.name: body_hash
columns.doc: ids@0.1 body hash; null when the engine derived none.

columns.name: caller_id
columns.doc: The enclosing declaration (the module's id for top-level code).

columns.name: callee_id
columns.doc: The declaration that can run; one row per candidate body on polymorphic.

columns.name: method_name
columns.doc: The name as written at the site. Not in the design's column list: a (file, line, col) site names more than one call in a chained expression, and the name is what tells them apart.

columns.name: receiver
columns.doc: The library type the call lands on, when known.

flow.doc: Def-use and taint edges. Empty from the java-graph@0.1 post-pass: these edges live on ids@0.1 node ids, which have no fixed-width form yet.

columns.name: target
columns.doc: The imported name as written, without a trailing `.*`; a static import's member path for `import static`.

columns.name: kind
columns.doc: entry-index@0.1 kinds plus the design's data-declared kinds; `bean` is the engine's name for the design's `di`.

columns.name: source
columns.doc: What declared the entry — the annotation, the supertype member, the manifest or file; the engine's evidence line.

moved.doc: Moves and renames between two snapshots: facts, not delete + insert. Empty from a single-snapshot post-pass.
